#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$(hostname)" == node2 ]]
export CENSUS_ROOT=/data/jzzeng/wb97m-canonical-shell-census-20261004
export PATH=/home/jzzeng/codes/wb97m-20261002/ccache/usr/bin:$PATH
export CCACHE_BASEDIR="$CENSUS_ROOT"
export SOURCE_ROOT=/data/jzzeng/wb97m-canonical-shared-rsh-20261004/cuda-source
export CUDA_ROOT=/group/software/cuda-12.9.1
cd "$CENSUS_ROOT"
ccache --version > ccache-version.txt
ccache --show-stats > ccache-before.txt
trap 'rc=$?; ccache --show-stats > ccache-after.txt; printf "{\"exit_code\":%s}\n" "$rc" > build-outcome.json' EXIT
ccache /usr/bin/g++-11 -std=c++20 -O3 -ffp-contract=off \
  -I"$SOURCE_ROOT/include" -I"$SOURCE_ROOT/src" -I"$CUDA_ROOT/include" \
  -c census.cpp -o census.o > build.log 2>&1
/usr/bin/g++-11 census.o -L"$SOURCE_ROOT/build/cuda-release-sm120" -lgenerativeqc \
  -L"$CUDA_ROOT/lib64" -lcudart -Wl,-rpath,"$CUDA_ROOT/lib64" -o census >> build.log 2>&1
sha256sum census.cpp census input.txt > files.sha256

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /data/jzzeng/wb97m-canonical-shared-rsh-20261004/environment.sh
export CENSUS_ROOT=/data/jzzeng/wb97m-canonical-shell-census-20261004
out="$CENSUS_ROOT/runs/$SLURM_JOB_ID"
mkdir -p "$out"
trap 'rc=$?; printf "{\"exit_code\":%s,\"job\":\"%s\"}\n" "$rc" "$SLURM_JOB_ID" > "$out/outcome.json"' EXIT
scontrol show job "$SLURM_JOB_ID" > "$out/slurm.txt"
nvidia-smi > "$out/device.txt"
sha256sum --check "$SHARED_ROOT/receipts/binaries.sha256" > "$out/native-binaries.txt"
"$SHARED_ENV/gpu-env/bin/python" "$SHARED_ROOT/verify-final.py" > "$out/source-identity.json"
cd "$CENSUS_ROOT"
sha256sum --check files.sha256 > "$out/probe-files.txt"
cp files.sha256 census.cpp run.sh "$out/"
cp input-provenance.json "$out/input-provenance.json"
timeout --kill-after=15 480 ./census input.txt > "$out/census.json" 2> "$out/census.log"

unset GENERATIVEQC_CANONICAL_RSH_VALUES

native/verify-final.py.text:
"""Bind diagnostic execution to the frozen source, binary and test inputs."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from tools.generate_build_identity import _inventory, _source_identity

root = Path.cwd()
experiment = Path(os.environ['SHARED_ROOT'])
expected = json.loads((experiment / 'expected-source.json').read_text())
inputs = _inventory(root, root / 'cmake/GenerativeQCSourceIdentity.json')
actual = _source_identity(root, inputs)
if actual != expected['identity']:
    raise ValueError('deployed production source differs from the frozen commit')
receipt = json.loads((experiment / 'receipts/source-identity.json').read_text())
if receipt['identity'] != actual:
    raise ValueError('compiled/deployed source identity differs')
for relative, digest in expected['tests'].items():
    if hashlib.sha256((root / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
        raise ValueError(f'test source differs: {relative}')
print(json.dumps({'commit': expected['commit'], 'source_identity': actual, 'inputs': len(inputs), 'tests': expected['tests']}, indent=2))
